subject.title: fix(anthropic): keep OAuth callback on loopback

question: Should Anthropic OAuth reject all non-loopback OPENCLAW_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST values while keeping the provider-visible redirect URI fixed at http://localhost:53692/callback?
rationale: The patch narrows an auth-provider environment surface and depends on a provider redirect contract that source inspection and mocked tests cannot fully settle.

options.title: Accept After Conflict And Proof
options.body: Refresh the branch, add redacted current-head CLI/login proof for invalid-host rejection and an allowed loopback callback path, then accept the fixed-localhost redirect contract.

options.title: Require Stronger Provider Proof
options.body: Ask for live Anthropic or installed-client evidence that localhost remains the accepted redirect URI for the supported loopback bind hosts before merge.

options.title: Pause For Auth Redesign
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer removing or redesigning the Anthropic OAuth callback-host override instead of hardening it narrowly.

recommendation.title: Accept After Conflict And Proof
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, add redacted current-head CLI/login proof for invalid-host rejection and an allowed loopback callback path, then accept the fixed-localhost redirect contract.
